visualCharacteristics.purpose: Intro text beside a contact form with labelled fields and a submit button

contentPattern.rows: first row is the intro; then one row per form field; one submit row; optional config rows

cells.name: Intro (row 1)
cells.content: heading, short text, contact email link

cells.name: Field row
cells.content: Label | type (text, email, tel, url, number, textarea, select, checkbox) | optional 'required' or select choices

cells.name: Config rows
cells.content: action | endpoint URL (POST JSON); success | thank-you message; error | failure message

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = intro (heading, text, email link); then one row per field as 'Label | type | required' (types: text, email, tel, url, number, textarea, select, checkbox; for select put the choices in cell 3); a 'Button label | submit' row; optional config rows 'action | endpoint URL' (POST JSON), 'success | message', 'error | message'. Without an action row nothing is sent

usage.description: Contact / enquiry section: heading, a line of supporting text and an email link on the left; a carded form with Name, Work email and Message fields and a full-width Send message button on the right.

reuseGuidance: Use for simple lead or contact forms. Without an 'action' row the form validates and shows the success message but sends nothing; add an 'action' row pointing to the form endpoint before go-live.
